doc.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

title: A Jewish pledge and a fraternity breaking with its national
summary: A house resigned from its national organization when it refused to take a Jewish pledge.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: of the houses — Lambda Chi I guess — and it came to the final signing up and there was — he had to sign a statement saying he was a Christian. And he looked at these guys and said, “But I can’t sign this, I’m Jewish.” And they said, “Well we didn’t know and we didn’t care” but they said, “we’re stuck.” So they called up the Theta Delta House, the president, they called the president of the Theta Delta House and said, “Hey we’ve got a situation here, can you do something about it?” And so Theta Delta called the national organization and said, “We’ve got a Jewish kid we want to take.” And they said no. Can’t do it. And they said, “Fine, we’re resigning from the national organization.” And the national backed down and they took this guy.
